name: David Keeling
current_role: Assistant Secretary of Labor for Occupational Safety and Health (since October 2025)
summary: David Keeling heads the Occupational Safety and Health Administration. He started at UPS as a package handler in 1985 and spent 38 years there, ending as vice president of global health and safety, then spent two years as a transportation-safety director at Amazon. Nominated in February 2025, he was confirmed in October 2025.
